Based on my audit of the IVX IA backend code, here are the answers:

## QA Audit: IVX IA Media Capabilities

### 1. Can IVX IA read pictures/images uploaded? — ✅ YES

The Owner AI backend (`ivx-owner-ai.ts`) has `extractImageAttachmentsFromBody()` which extracts image URLs from the request body (attachments, imageUrls, imageUrl fields). The system prompt explicitly states:

> *"Vision: when image attachments are provided with the request, you CAN see them — describe what is shown, extract visible text, and audit screenshots."*

Runs on **gpt-4o** (multimodal — vision + documents). Also has `ocrDocumentBytes()` for OCR on scanned images.

### 2. Can IVX IA read PDF and any document uploaded? — ✅ YES

`extractDocumentAttachmentsFromBody()` extracts **PDF, spreadsheet, docx, csv, txt** files. The code comment says:

> *"Extract non-image deal documents (PDF, spreadsheet, docx, csv, txt) from the request body so the Owner AI can actually READ them — not just images."*

Also has `ocrDocumentBytes()` for scanned/image-only PDFs — hands raw bytes to gpt-4o as a `file` content part for true OCR.

### 3. Can IVX IA send voice chat (voice messages)? — ❌ NO

**Voice CALLS** work (SignalWire LaML with `<Say>` text-to-speech on live calls + conversational Gather loop). **Speech-to-text INPUT** exists (ElevenLabs Scribe / OpenAI Whisper via `ivx-transcription-core.ts`).

But there is **no text-to-speech (TTS) for voice message replies** — the IVX IA cannot generate and send a voice message/audio clip back in chat. It always replies with **text only**.
